name: BrickEconomy API
description: OpenAPI description derived from the public BrickEconomy API reference. The current reference documents five GET endpoints under /api/v1: /set/{setNumber}, /minifig/{minifigNumber}, /collection/sets, /collection/minifigs, and /salesledger. All requests require an x-apikey header and the docs also state that clients must send User-Agent and Accept: application/json. Successful responses are generally wrapped as { "data": ... }. The docs explicitly warn that some response fields may be omitted depending on object state, so this specification keeps most schema properties optional. Where the docs and payload examples disagree, this spec prefers a permissive schema and notes the discrepancy.
